clauses.clause_label: 3(a) Hosted Service restriction and single-customer exception
clauses.scope_note: Use of the Software, in whole or in part, to provide a Hosted Service to third parties is prohibited without prior written authorization. The text gives examples including multi-tenant platforms, managed services enabling third parties to create, configure, or run agents, and reselling cloud access. Exception: deployment for one customer in a dedicated single-tenant environment is allowed only if it serves that customer exclusively; the customer grants no access to or shares it with another third party; use is solely for that customer's internal business operations and is not a reusable multi-customer platform; it is not shared across tenants; and FIM One branding, product names, copyright notices, and branding remain visible and unaltered.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the licensee provides a Hosted Service to third parties without prior written authorization and the single-customer exception's requirements are not all met. The exception requires all five listed conditions; prior written authorization is a separate route stated in the text.
